en.title: Pairs of Products Whose Prices Sum to a Power of 3
en.description:
Count product pairs with distinct indices i<j such that price[i]+price[j] equals 3^e for some non-negative integer e, including 3^0=1. Different products with the same price are counted as different index combinations.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n; the second line contains the prices. The original text gave no numeric bounds; this site uses 1≤n≤200000, 0≤price≤10^9.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
hints: Enumerate the powers of 3 up to the largest possible sum. Scan the prices in order; for each one, look up how many times each complement appeared earlier, then add the current price.
